entries.title: Proverbs 3:1
segments: My son, forget not My law; but let your heart keep My commandments;

entries.title: Proverbs 3:2
segments: for they shall add length of days, and long life, and peace, to you.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:3
segments: Let not mercy and truth forsake you; tie them around your neck; write them upon the tablet of your heart;

entries.title: Proverbs 3:4
segments: and you shall find favor and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:5
segments: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not to your own understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:6
segments: In all your ways acknowledge Him, and He shall direct your paths.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:7
segments: Do not be wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD and depart from evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:8
segments: Healing shall be to your navel and marrow to your bones.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:9
segments: Honor the LORD with your substance, and with the firstfruits of all your increase;

entries.title: Proverbs 3:10
segments: and your barns shall be filled [with] plenty, and your presses shall burst [with] new wine.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:11
segments: My son, do not despise the chastening of the LORD; nor be weary with His correction;

entries.title: Proverbs 3:12
segments: for whom the LORD loves He corrects, even as a father [corrects] the son [in whom] he delights.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:13
segments: Blessed [is] the man who finds wisdom, and the man who gets understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:14
segments: For the profit from it [is] better than the gain from silver, and its produce more than fine gold;

entries.title: Proverbs 3:15
segments: she [is] more precious than rubies; and all the things you can desire are not to be compared with her.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:16
segments: Length of days [is] in her right hand; and in her left hand, riches and honor.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:17
segments: Her ways [are] ways of pleasantness, and all her paths [are] peace.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:18
segments: She [is] a tree of life to those who lay hold upon her; and happy [is] everyone who keeps her.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:19
segments: The LORD has founded the earth by wisdom; by understanding He has founded the heavens.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:20
segments: By His knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:21
segments: My son, do not let them depart from your eyes; keep sound wisdom and judgment,

entries.title: Proverbs 3:22
segments: and they shall be life to your soul and grace to your neck.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:23
segments: Then you shall walk in your way safely, and your foot shall not stumble.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:24
segments: When you lie down, you shall not be afraid; yea, you shall lie down, and your sleep shall be sweet.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:25
segments: Do not be afraid of sudden fear, nor of the destroying of the wicked, when it comes.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:26
segments: For the LORD shall be your hope, and shall keep your foot from being taken.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:27
segments: Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do [it].

entries.title: Proverbs 3:28
segments: Do not say to your neighbor, Go and come back again, and tomorrow I will give; when you have it beside you:

entries.title: Proverbs 3:29
segments: Do not plan evil against your neighbor, since he dwells trustingly by you.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:30
segments: Do not strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:31
segments: Do not envy the cruel man, and choose none of his ways.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:32
segments: For the crooked man [is] hateful to the LORD, but His secret [is] with the righteous.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:33
segments: The curse of the LORD [is] in the house of the wicked; but He blesses the home of the just.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:34
segments: Surely He scorns the scorners; but He gives grace to the lowly.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:35
segments: The wise shall inherit glory; but shame shall be the promotion of fools.
